_source: TFRSupplyConfiguratorSettings.docx — SpectraLux ILS dependency-driven configurator spec
_note: Dependency-driven configurator: selecting one option restricts others (`dependencies` on a step), auto-bundles accessories (`auto_bundle` on an option), or changes the SKU. pricing_model=dynamic_build because the final price/SKU is computed from the full combination of selections rather than looked up from one fixed catalog SKU (unlike sku-selector configurators such as valor-configurator.json). Vehicle SKU segments (FPIU, TAH, CHGR, DUR, FD, SIL, CMRY, EXPD, UNIV) confirmed against real SIFM*/SIFZ* SKUs in shopify-variant-index.json. Ford Police Interceptor Sedan, Ram 1500, Chevrolet Equinox, and Chevrolet Traverse have no confirmed SKU segment in the current Shopify export — flagged _verification: needs_verification. Fitment-kit accessory SKUs and prices are not in the price book yet — do NOT invent them; sku/price are null with a _note pending confirmation.
label: SpectraLux® ILS Configurator

skuSelector.label: Build Your SpectraLux ILS
skuSelector.description: Each step narrows or unlocks later steps based on the dependency matrix below. Vehicle Fitment auto-bundles the matching shroud/mounting kit; Mounting Location determines which Module Coverage options are available; Control Architecture gates Control Hardware; LED Color Technology limits Primary Warning Colors and whether Takedown & Scene Lighting is available.

options.description: Best for straight-on warning.

options.description: Used for SignalMaster directional warning.

options.description: Used for SignalMaster directional warning.

options.description: Front headliner only.

options.label: Driver-Side Only (4-Head)
options.description: Front headliner only.

options.label: Passenger-Side Only (4-Head)
options.description: Front headliner only.

options.label: Rear 8-Head
options.description: Rear Deck or Rear Hatch only.

options.label: Rear 6-Head
options.description: Rear Deck or Rear Hatch only.

options.label: FS Convergence Network (Serial, CAT5)
options.description: Requires an FS Convergence controller (e.g. Pathfinder, SmartSiren) or a Serial Interface Module.

options.label: Discrete Wire (8-Conductor Cable)
options.description: Disables FS Convergence Network features (V2V sync via Pathfinder, software-driven OBDII automation). Changes the internal PCB and external harnessing from CAT5 to discrete cable.

options.label: Using Existing Pathfinder / SmartSiren Controller
options.description: No additional controller hardware required.

options.label: Add Serial Interface Module
options.description: Required when no FS Convergence controller is already present in the vehicle.

options.label: Add 6-Button Serial Controller
options.description: Dedicated 6-button controller for the SpectraLux ILS.

options.label: Single-Color
options.description: One warning color per module.

options.label: Dual-Color
options.description: Two colors per module (e.g. Red/Blue warning switching to White takedowns).

options.label: Tri-Color (SpectraLux®)
options.description: Three colors per module (e.g. Red/Blue warning, White takedowns, Amber directional arrows).

steps.label: Primary Warning Colors
steps._note: Single-Color allows exactly one primary color. Dual-Color and Tri-Color (SpectraLux) allow Custom Split (a custom multi-color PCB layout) in addition to any single color.

options.label: Custom Split
options.description: Custom PCB layout — requires Dual-Color or Tri-Color LED technology.

steps.label: Takedown & Scene Lighting
steps._note: If LED Color Technology = Single-Color, White Takedowns is disabled UNLESS Primary Warning Colors = White (see dependencyMatrix rule rule-single-color-disables-white-takedowns).

options.label: White Takedowns
options.description: Requires Dual-Color or Tri-Color LED selection with white diodes, unless the primary color is already White.

options.label: Full Scene/Flood
options.description: Requires Dual-Color or Tri-Color LED selection with white diodes, unless the primary color is already White.

dependencyMatrix.message: Rear Deck and Rear Hatch mounting are used for SignalMaster directional warning and limit Module Size to 8-head or 6-head configurations.
Front Headliner mounting allows Split 8-head, Driver-only 4-head, or Passenger-only 4-head module configurations.

disables: FS Convergence Network features (V2V sync via Pathfinder, software-driven OBDII automation)

dependencyMatrix.message: Discrete Wire control disables FS Convergence Network features such as V2V sync via Pathfinder and software-driven OBDII automation.
Single-Color LED technology disables White Takedowns unless the primary color selected in Primary Warning Colors is White.
Brackets and shrouds will require manual bending, cutting, and trimming to fit the windshield.

_price_source: This configurator uses pricing_model=dynamic_build: price is computed from the combined selections (vehicle fitment kit + light bar assembly + control hardware + LED/color options), not looked up from a single fixed Shopify SKU. No prices are set here — do not invent them.
